marta: Quick sync: onboarding harness exposed a new failure mode. When many clients start concurrently they probe /v1/limits, some probes succeed with low limits and others time out -> we end up with mismatched client-side buckets and a brief burst that trips per-tenant caps.
evan: Can you paste the observed headers?
marta: Example from one run:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-rate-limit-limit: 12
x-rate-limit-remaining: 11
x-rate-limit-reset: 9
```
Other workers saw probe timeouts and defaulted to a high fallback in our sampleapp.
jia: Oof. Two problems: 1) inconsistent seeding of token buckets, 2) no single-flight auth refresh so refresh storms still happen.
evan: Proposed mitigations: a) make probe atomic per-customer (use X-Client-Id and share seed across client instances during startup), b) conservative fallback (5 rps) if probe times out, c) ramp seeds across workers instead of instant start.
marta: Also add a `leakyBucket` limiter that can be seeded from probe and will adapt to observed `x-rate-limit-*` headers at runtime. If header drops, shrink bucket quickly.
jia: For retries use decorrelated jitter per AWS paper: `sleep = base * (2^attempt) + random(0, base)` and for 429 prefer honoring `x-rate-limit-reset` + jitter.
evan: I'll implement single-flight refresh in the JS and Python SDKs and expose `SDK_ONBOARD_RAMP_MS` env. For sampleapps default to `clientConcurrency=6`, `prefetchPages=1`, and `probeTimeoutMs=200`.
marta: Can we add an integration test that mocks mixed probe outcomes? Test should assert that final steady inflight < seeded limit and no more than N calls/sec to mocked /v1/chat.
ops-bot: Alert: onboarding-harness-prod saw quota spike at 2026-03-24T02:12:47Z; mitigation: applied temporary per-tenant throttle.
jia: I'll open cross-repo PRs and a short devex note. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard-samples/pull/501 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/909
evan: Also instrument telemetry: emit `sdk.rate_probe.success`, `sdk.rate_probe.timeout`, and attach `sdk.bucket.seed` to onboarding spans. That should make future tuning data-driven.
marta: Thanks. After PRs land we should run the harness with varied network latencies to ensure stable seeding behavior.
